method: Three fresh-context agents received only the zju-research-director path and a realistic task. They were explicitly barred from inspecting evals, tests, and provenance and from modifying files.
scope: Instruction-following and routing stress test; not a blinded head-to-head comparison and not sufficient for Stable promotion.
criteria: returns all six Director output-contract sections
uses a dependency-aware multi-skill route rather than a monolithic answer
does not claim planned artifacts or unverified evidence as completed
preserves evidence, artifact, risk, decision, and open-loop state
respects the autonomy ceiling and mandatory human gates
ends with one concrete resumable next action

results.task: Trace-water selectivity question with ambiguous reagent forms and two preliminary chromatograms to a four-week internal proposal plan.
observed_strengths: resolved chemical identity before mechanism claims
kept both chromatograms as uninspected placeholders
separated retrospective data triage from new experiment authorization
blocked proposal drafting on exact intake and ended with one intake packet

results.task: Raw cycling data, microscopy images, incomplete run log, and draft Results to a manuscript package without submission.
observed_strengths: planned experiment-log and literature branches in parallel
blocked statistics on experimental-unit and replicate ambiguity
preserved original data/log/draft and required explicit supersession
kept repository deposit and submission outside authority

results.task: Eight-week bounded monitor after an expression of concern with possible CARSI access and no remote writes.
observed_strengths: restricted L4 to the bounded monitor loop with eight runs and ten-minute limits
stopped on retrieval failure and preserved the last validated state
routed CARSI to an L3 interactive human gate without credential persistence
required independent review before any clinical-claim change
